_schema: Example only: every name, price, offer, rating and URL here is a placeholder. Copy this file, replace everything with what you found today, and delete this _schema field. Required: request.category, checked_on, advice, and 1-5 picks. Each pick needs name, best_for, why (list), drawbacks (list), at least one price {site, price, url, checked_on} and at least one source {title, url}. Optional: request.pincode (6 digits or empty), request.cards (list of the buyer's cards), key_specs (object), prices[].variant, prices[].delivery (yes | no | not_checked), prices[].delivery_pincode (the pincode the store checked; required for yes/no when request.pincode is empty), offers: list of {site, type: bank | emi | exchange | coupon | sale | other, text (as the store words it), saving (₹, instant discount only), conditions, applies_to_buyer (true/false), url} — use [] when none were found, with offers_note saying where you looked; reviews: {ratings: [{site, rating (0-5), count, url}], expert: [{source, score, verdict, url}], praise: [..], complaints: [..]}; service {status: found | not_found | not_checked, detail, url}, also_considered [{name, why_not}], assumptions (list), not_confirmed (list).
